description: This class provides functionality to parse a string message representing engine chart data, unpacking it into a Map structure and returning an EngineChart object.

classes.name: EngineChartParser
classes.description: Provides static methods for parsing engine chart data messages into EngineChart objects.

methods.name: unpackToMap
methods.description: Converts a delimited string message into an EngineChart object by unpacking key-value pairs into a map.
